name: FRONT DESK
blurb: Intake forms, PINs, the fake smile. Profile lives here.

name: STREET MAP
blurb: A corkboard of alleys. Unlocks the Run tab so you can actually go outside.

name: THERAPY COUCH
blurb: Stained. Expensive. This is the CBT Tree, billed as growth.

name: WARDROBE CAGE
blurb: Headbands, polos, a cape that is not a license.

name: TROPHY CABINET
blurb: Awards you have to claim. Growth is not automatic. Neither is Gold.

name: MAIL SLOT
blurb: The Session Log. Gifts, threats, invoices from the therapist.

name: BULLETIN BOARD
blurb: Daily coping goals. Check a box. Open a chest. Call it progress.

name: COMPARE MIRRORS
blurb: Build Compare. Split-screen menus only. Nobody splits the street.

name: BLOOD FRIDGE
blurb: Between-run snacks. Gold goes in. Bandages come out. Science.

name: CAMP SHOP
blurb: Build it. Then the wheel, the slots, the chests. Upgrade expands stock.

name: QUICK PATROL
blurb: 2×/day. Idle gold and XP while the game is closed and while you play.

name: RESEARCH CENTER
blurb: Silencers, mags, hollow feelings. Parts in, caliber out.

name: MARTIAL ARTS SCHOOL
blurb: Learn moves. Master ranks. Shaolin badges. The Son already teaches this.

name: WORKSHOP
blurb: Parts, coils, thread, ink. Gear and clothes are one build.
